$comment: RULES THIS INVESTIGATION LEARNED BY BREAKING THEM.
Each rule below exists because a probe in this project produced a wrong answer that the rule
would have caught, and each names the phase where that happened. They are recorded as data so
a later probe can be checked against them, not as advice.

rules.rule: A probe must establish whether the production system already recognises and discloses the alleged condition BEFORE classifying it as a defect.
what_happened: A probe found ten families collecting `liability_cap_amount` while the clause stated a formula,
and was one step from reporting that the user's figure never reaches the page — the D4.14 class
of failure, and a serious find if true.
draftConsistencyValidator.js already reports it as LIABILITY_CAP_ANSWERS_CONFLICT. The user also
chose a BASIS, the clause follows the basis, and the validator says in terms that the figure has
not been used. The behaviour is correct and already disclosed.
rules.why_it_matters: Without this rule the measurement probes become a source of false legal conclusions — the exact failure mode they exist to prevent, arriving through the instrument meant to prevent it.
rules.how_to_apply: Generate the document, read the validation output, and only then decide whether silence is real.

rules.rule: Where a probe's word list determines its verdict, the word list must be derived from what the schemas and artifacts actually contain, and a verdict already computed must be reused rather than re-derived from a second list.
what_happened: D4.21: four detector defects produced 34 false candidates out of 59.
D4.22: ablation showed five of six known-sensitive clauses become undiscoverable once their
vocabulary is removed — the detectors recognise words, not mechanisms.
D4.27: three separate word-list defects in ONE probe. `total_fee` and `price` were missing, and
a fee-specific regex misclassified lease, employment and guarantee, whose caps read rent, salary
and the guaranteed amount.
Every time this investigation has written a vocabulary, the vocabulary has been wrong.

rules.rule: Where a legal conclusion turns on a statute or authority, the probe must read what that source actually does before building on it. A plausible mechanism that reaches the right conclusion is still wrong, and the generalisation drawn from it will not survive.
what_happened: D4.25: it was tempting to record that Contract Act s.146 resolves the cap/indemnity conflict in
the guarantee family. It does not. It allocates as between co-sureties while the cap bounds the
creditor's recovery — different axes, so there was no conflict for it to resolve. Right
conclusion, wrong mechanism, and the generalisation drawn from it would have failed wherever no
statute exists.
D4.28: secondary sources state that excluding liability for death or personal injury caused by
negligence is 'automatically void', attributing it to COMMON LAW PRINCIPLES. India has no Unfair
Contract Terms Act. The constraint runs through s.23 public policy and Central Inland Water
Transport unconscionability, which are fact-sensitive. Recording it as a bright line would have
rested an Indian answer on another jurisdiction's statute.

rules.rule: State a quantitative consequence by computing it in the probe, not by asserting it in prose.
what_happened: The narrative said SHARED + SEVERAL_TO_EACH conflicts while PER_PARTY + SEVERAL_TO_EACH is
coherent. The arithmetic showed PER_PARTY permits 30,00,000 against 50,00,000 promised, so that
pairing fails too. The tension was structural rather than a quirk of one combination, and the
prose had the shape of the finding wrong.

rules.rule: A regression fixture asserts the current state, including when that state is a defect. It must never assert a solution that has not landed.
what_happened: The cap/indemnity fixture asserts that the document does NOT order the two clauses, with a
failure message saying that if it ever flips, that may be the fix landing and the governance
record should be updated rather than the assertion allowed to change silently.
A test that passes by describing a hoped-for state is how a suite starts lying.

rules.rule: Where a finding turns on a quantitative relationship, the fixture must supply realistic, NON-COLLIDING values. A fixture that answers every numeric question with the same number cannot distinguish a sound magnitude from an absurd one, and cannot distinguish a correct formula from several incorrect ones. Output that looks like a defect must be checked against the input that produced it before it is reported as one.
what_happened: Reading rendered text across the portfolio turned up `The liability of the Obligor under this
Deed is limited to Rs. 3/-` in INDEMNITY_BOND and `an amount equal to 0.3 times the amount
invested` in TERM_SHEET. A three-rupee indemnity bond and a 0.3x liquidation preference are
both commercially absurd, and both were one step from being recorded as defects.
Neither is one. The WELL_FILLED fixture answers every numeric question with 3, and 0.3 for a
multiple. The engine rendered the answers it was given, correctly.
The cost is not the near-miss. It is that no probe built on this fixture can test D4.28's
WELL_DEFINED sub-question at all, because every magnitude in it is the same magnitude.
probeLeaseCapHeads had to supply its own figures for exactly this reason and that was treated
as a convenience at the time; it was a requirement.
rules.why_it_matters: This is the inverse of the D4.19 rule. There, a fixture that could not reach a behaviour reported it as absent. Here, a fixture that reaches every behaviour with one value reports every magnitude as equally plausible.
rules.how_to_apply: Before reporting a quantity as wrong, print the input that produced it. Before concluding that magnitudes are sound, check that the fixture varies them.

$why: The uniform value does two kinds of damage and the second is worse.
It hides magnitude: a three-rupee indemnity bond looks like a defect and is not.
It hides FORMULA ERROR: where fee, investment, cap and claim are all 3, a cap computed from
the wrong quantity produces the right number. Several incorrect formulas agree, and a suite
that exercises every path reports confidence it has not earned.
The fixture proves the path works. It does not prove the semantics work, and this
investigation has been reading its green as though it proved both.
non_collision.requirement: Distinct, realistic, mutually non-divisible values per quantity, so that a formula reading the wrong one produces a visibly wrong answer.
non_collision.status: the existing WELL_FILLED fixture does not meet this and has not been changed; changing it would move the clause baseline and is its own piece of work

rules.rule: Before a probe's output is treated as a finding, the probe itself must be attacked: its vocabulary, its fixture, its assumption that silence means absence, and whether the production system already says what it is about to report. A probe is an instrument and an unexamined instrument produces confident nonsense.
what_happened: This investigation has now retracted seven claims before recording them, listed in
`retraction_register` below. Every one came from the measurement apparatus rather than from
the product.
That ratio is the finding. For a system whose purpose is to refuse to fabricate legal content,
a measurement methodology that fabricates defects is the same failure arriving through the
instrument built to prevent it.
rules.why_it_matters: Finding defects in the product is the visible work. Discovering how readily the method invents them is what makes the visible work trustworthy.
rules.how_to_apply: For each probe, before reading its output: what decides this verdict, and what would make that wrong? Then check that specific thing.

rules.rule: No legal proposition becomes executable knowledge on the strength of this investigation's own assertion. It must be verified against sources, each source's weight recorded, and anything that could not be confirmed left marked as reported rather than established.
what_happened: D4.29 characterised a nil ceiling as a total exclusion and recorded a legal frame around it
from recollection. Verification against Indian sources found the draft wrong in BOTH directions:
It UNDERSTATED the authority against damage-barring clauses — there is a named line of decisions
holding them void under s.23, not merely a fact-sensitive argument.
It OVERSTATED the unconscionability doctrine, which does not reach equal-bargaining commercial
transactions.
It MISSED the Consumer Protection Act 2019 entirely, which changes the answer for the two
consumer-facing families.
And the central characterisation turned out to be precisely the question the authorities leave
open, rather than a conclusion they support.
rules.why_it_matters: A plausible legal frame is the most dangerous output this system can produce, because it is the one a reader is least equipped to check.
rules.how_to_apply: Record the authority, the court, what it decides, its bearing on the question, and how it was verified. Where it was not read, say so and do not cite it.

rules.rule: A suite result is evidence only about the tree it ran against, and the run must be able to name that tree. A number reported from a working copy that cannot state its commit is not evidence about the product.
what_happened: Three times across D4.29 and D4.30 this investigation reported "314 checks green, no baseline
drift". Every one of those runs was made in a copy whose knowledge-base differed from the
product's, and on the product every single document type failed to generate.
THE COVERAGE WAS NEVER MISSING. documentRequirements.test.mjs calls
loadDocumentRequirements({refresh:true}) at module scope; on the product tree it dies on import
with the exact error the users were seeing. Restoring the pre-fix files and running that one
file reproduces it in full. The suite was right and the measurement was wrong.
The copy had no provenance at all — `git status` in it answered "fatal: not a git repository".
It could not name a commit, and it produced a number that read exactly like one that could.
rules.why_it_matters: This is the probe-shadows-production failure at repository scale. documentRequirements.js already carries a comment about a probe fixture silently replacing a family's authored requirements, noting it happened four times. The same mistake one level up is harder to see and costs more: it does not corrupt one measurement, it makes every measurement unattributable.
rules.how_to_apply: Run the suite in the repository. Where that is impossible, say in the report which tree was measured and what is known to differ — and do not state the number as a property of the product.

rules.rule: Two artifacts are not independent evidence when one derives its population, or its content, from the other. Before citing agreement between them, establish that neither was built from the other.
what_happened: DOCUMENT_TYPE_REGISTRY contains 40 document types. tests/baseline/clause-baseline.json contains
the same 40. Read as two artifacts agreeing, that is strong support for 40 being the right
population — and it supports nothing at all, because freezeClauseBaseline.mjs builds the
baseline by iterating the registry.
The coincidence was doubly inviting here: 40 is also the historical count, so the agreement
could have been read as the lost population having been recovered. It has not been.
rules.why_it_matters: This is how a derived artifact becomes a second witness. A later investigator sees two files saying 40 and stops asking.
rules.how_to_apply: For each artifact cited in support, name what produced it. Where one produced the other, say so in the same breath as the agreement.

cap_decomposition.$note: The five layers the investigation separated, in the order they must be answered. None may resolve another as a side effect.

layers.question: What quantity does the ceiling refer to, can it arise here, can it be established when a claim is made, and can the instrument compute it?

sub_questions.question: Can the class of payment the clause names arise between these parties under this instrument at all?
sub_questions.result: 7 of 22 cap instances name a class of payment that never arises in their family, and 3 more turn on whether a contribution to a firm, a JV vehicle or a company is a payment between the Parties. Where it cannot arise the ceiling is nil, so the clause is an exclusion of liability rather than a limitation of it.
sub_questions.$why_first: It precedes COMPUTABLE because an empty referent is not a missing field. Asking whether the formula can be computed invites the repair of adding the field, and adding a fee to a partnership deed is not a repair.

sub_questions.question: Granted that the quantity can arise, can the parties establish what it was when a claim is made?
$why_it_is_its_own_rung: A referent can be non-empty and still not observable. Fees paid in the preceding twelve
months are observable from invoices. The value of an opportunity lost, or consideration
described but never quantified anywhere, can genuinely arise and still leave the ceiling
undeterminable at the moment it matters.
Collapsing this into COMPUTABLE would once again invite the intake repair — add a field —
when the defect is that the quantity is not knowable from any record either party keeps.
sub_questions.status: OPEN — not yet measured across the portfolio

sub_questions.question: Is there a quantity the formula can read?
sub_questions.result: 10 of 22 cap instances cannot be computed

sub_questions.question: Is what it computes stable and intended?
sub_questions.result: A cumulative measure makes the ceiling a function of elapsed time. In a commercial lease at 2,50,000 per month, the same clause recovers 6 percent of a 40,00,000 claim in month one and 100 percent from month sixteen. MEASURABLE was necessary and not sufficient.

layers.question: Which exposure heads does the ceiling reach at all?
Which heads are expressly outside it?
Per head, how do other exposure provisions affect it?
How does the ceiling apply across more than two principals?

finding_taxonomy.finding: 4 families offer a cap basis they cannot supply
6 families contain a fixed basis nothing can measure
the cumulative measure makes the ceiling time-dependent
7 families name a payment class that never arises, so the ceiling is nil
finding_taxonomy.$members_not_duplicated_here: The membership has one home. Copying it would let the two records drift.

finding_taxonomy.finding: the negotiated-cap basis option renders the default fees formula and collects no figure

$correction: D4.27 recorded that a family has one defect kind per layer. D4.29 falsified that.
DISTRIBUTION_AGREEMENT and SHAREHOLDERS_AGREEMENT each carry BOTH defects at the MEASURE
layer: the form offers a fees basis the family cannot supply, which is an intake defect owned
by product, AND the clause names fees that can never arise between these parties, which is a
content defect owned by knowledge. Two repairs, two owners, one family.
The rule that survives is narrower: a FINDING has one nature. A family may appear in several
findings, and the reason to keep the natures apart is that they route to different people, not
taxonomy_note.rule: A finding has exactly one nature. A family may appear in more than one finding.

$note: These are not implementation features and they are not preferences. Each is a boundary that,
if crossed, makes the system assert something no advocate decided. They are recorded here
rather than in a family file because they bind every family.

constraints.constraint: A ceiling that computes to zero must never be treated as a ceiling that is present and satisfied. Zero is a substantive answer and must be surfaced as one; unknown is the absence of an answer. The two must not share a signal.
why: A formula whose referent cannot arise is formally computable and substantively catastrophic.
It yields nil, and nil passes every structural check a 'is there a cap?' test can apply.
The document then carries a reassuring cap-present signal over a total bar on recovery.
An unknown ceiling fails safe in the reader's mind — it looks incomplete and invites
negotiation. A nil ceiling does not look incomplete.
constraints.test_form: No check may report a cap as present on the strength of the clause rendering. Presence is a property of the referent, not of the sentence.

constraints.constraint: The relationship between the cap and other exposure provisions is decided per exposure head. No single Boolean may stand for it.
why: The shipped cap already carves out three heads — fraud, wilful misconduct, and liabilities
unlimitable by law — while the indemnity triggers on three, overlapping on exactly one. The
instrument is therefore ALREADY ordering the two clauses in part.
A field such as `indemnity_inside_cap = true/false` would overwrite three settled heads in
order to answer two open ones. It would answer more than the advocate decided, which is the
specific way this system would fabricate legal content while appearing to record a choice.

constraints.constraint: MEASURE, INTERACTION and APPORTIONMENT are separate questions with separate authority. No result from one may resolve another as a side effect.

shape.MEASURE: what does the ceiling refer to?
shape.INTERACTION: per head, how do other exposure provisions bear on it?
shape.APPORTIONMENT: with more than two principals, among whom does it apply?

why: D4.29 showed how easily one answers another by accident. Establishing that the NDA's cap is
nil makes the interaction question look answered — the indemnity is simply consumed — and it
is not answered, it is merely rendered stark. Recording it as decided would take a measurement
result and pass it off as an interaction decision.
constraints.worked_example_of_the_temptation: knowledge-base/governance/cap-referent.json#interaction_layer_note, which records the NDA chain and explicitly does not decide it.

constraints.constraint: A defect in what the form offers and a defect in what the instrument says are routed to different people and repaired differently, even when they appear in the same family and the same layer.
constraints.why: DISTRIBUTION_AGREEMENT and SHAREHOLDERS_AGREEMENT carry both at MEASURE: the form offers a fees basis they cannot supply, and the clause names fees that can never arise between these parties. Two repairs, two owners, one family.
constraints.superseded_claim: D4.27's 'a family has one defect kind per layer', falsified in D4.29.

constraints.constraint: An absent executable scope must never be read as evidence that the authored scope is universal. Where a constraint's prose names an instrument class and its declaration names none, that is a SCOPE_ENCODING_GAP, not a statement that the rule applies everywhere.
shape: AUTHORED_SCOPE  exists — 'Employment contract must define the employee's role and duties.'
EXECUTABLE_SCOPE absent — no applies_to_doc_types, no excludes_doc_types, no excludes_shapes
must NOT be silently interpreted as UNIVERSAL
why: The evaluator's primitive — an undeclared allow-list means the rule applies to everything — is
defensible in the abstract and dangerous for authored legal constraints, because it converts
'we have not encoded what the author said'
into
'the author said this applies everywhere'.
Those are opposite claims. One is an admission of incompleteness; the other is an assertion of
legal reach that no advocate made.
Measured consequence: 342 employment-rule failures across 39 of 40 families, including a
partnership deed failing a statutory social-security requirement.
constraints.governed_condition: Scope-encoding completeness is a condition of production validity for an authored constraint. A rule whose prose names an instrument class and whose declaration names none is not production-valid, whatever its assertions do.
constraints.$not_done: The evaluator was NOT changed. Changing the primitive before the thirteen scope decisions exist would replace one unauthored default with another.

retraction_register.reading: 14 retractions across seven phases. Classes: PROBE_DEFECT, VOCABULARY, ASSERTED_NOT_COMPUTED, LEGAL_MECHANISM, ALREADY_DISCLOSED, FIXTURE, OWN_PRIOR_RULE, PREMATURE_ABSTRACTION, LEGAL_FRAME, MEASURED_THE_WRONG_TREE, WRONG_LOCATION. Vocabulary is the most frequent, the legal ones are the most dangerous, and MEASURED_THE_WRONG_TREE is the most expensive: it did not corrupt one finding, it made every finding in two phases unattributable until re-run.

$note: Without this, the investigation becomes a backdoor knowledge-authoring system. The failure mode
is short and entirely plausible:
researcher observes something -> writes a proposition -> a test passes -> the system
treats the proposition as law
Every step there is something this project does daily, and the last one is fabrication. A green
test proves the record is internally consistent. It proves nothing whatever about the law.
knowledge_authoring_pipeline.applies_to: LEGAL propositions. A mechanical observation about what the software does — that an option renders the default formula, that a field is absent — is established by generating and reading, and does not pass through these gates.

gates.question: What did the instrument actually do? Established by generating and reading, never by summarising.
What legal claim would explain it? Explicitly a candidate, and labelled as one.
What do the sources say? Each authority read or marked REPORTED_UNVERIFIED, with its court, date, facts, what it decided and what it did not.
Does it reach OUR facts? Which parties, which contractual context, which statute, which exceptions. This is where a correct proposition most often stops.
Does a qualified advocate adopt it? Nothing in this repository has passed this gate.
Only now may it drive generation, validation or certification.

current_positions.proposition: A cap measured on a payment class that never arises produces a nil ceiling.
current_positions.note: An arithmetic consequence of an observation, not a legal claim. Established.

current_positions.proposition: A nil ceiling is a total exclusion of liability rather than a limitation.
current_positions.outcome: FAILED AT GATE 3 and returned to gate 2, reframed. Verification found the authorities draw the line between absolute bars and threshold caps and do not address a formula that evaluates to nil. The claim became the question.

current_positions.proposition: Simplex Concrete Piles does not address clauses that cap damages at a threshold.
current_positions.note: Judgment read; the limitation confirmed in the text rather than inferred. Awaiting gate 4 — whether a government standard-form construction contract's reasoning reaches an NDA between commercial parties.

current_positions.proposition: Consumer Protection Act 2019 s.49(2) permits a term unfair to a consumer to be declared void.
current_positions.note: Section text read. Gate 4 is open and substantial: whether a liability ceiling in published terms of service is a term 'unfair to a consumer' within s.2(46), and whether the reader is a consumer at all.

current_positions.proposition: PLUS 91 limits Simplex to absolute prohibitions.
current_positions.note: Held at gate 2 deliberately. The law report was read and does not discuss Simplex; the limitation is the practitioner literature's reading. It is the distinction this whole finding turns on, so it is the one least entitled to be assumed.

knowledge_authoring_pipeline.$standing: Nothing in this repository has passed gate 5. 308 clauses carry no advocate sign-off and every governance record is marked draft-needs-legal-review. That is the accurate state and it should not drift silently.

$note: MEASURE, INTERACTION and APPORTIONMENT all assume the clause IS a ceiling. D4.29 produced a case
where that assumption is the question, so characterisation is recorded as a DIMENSION beside the
three layers rather than as a fourth layer within them — it is prior to all three, not after them.
fourth_dimension.question: Is this actually a cap, or an exclusion or bar?
fourth_dimension.hard_constraint: ARITHMETIC_DOES_NOT_DETERMINE_CHARACTERISATION — a legal characterisation may never be inferred from a computed value.
fourth_dimension.not_generalised: Scoped to the liability ceiling. No evidence yet shows the problem recurs in other clause families, and generalising without it would be the abstraction this investigation refused in D4.29.

property_the_suite_must_keep.property: The test suite must be capable of failing because a hypothesis of ours was wrong, not only because the product regressed.
how_it_is_achieved: Fixtures assert the CURRENT state including defects, so a repair flips them and forces the governance record to be updated rather than the assertion quietly relaxed.
Governance records are asserted, so softening a rule, dropping an authority or hardening a provisional reading into a verdict fails a test.
Refusals carry their evidence, so accepting a previously refused abstraction fails unless the evidence is replaced.
demonstrated_in: D4.29 — adding REFERENT_NON_EMPTY failed the sub-question assertion, which is what forced the change to be deliberate.
D4.29 — the taxonomy check that asserted 'one defect kind per family' failed once DISTRIBUTION and SHAREHOLDERS were found to carry two. Our rule was wrong and the suite said so.
D4.30 — the legal-frame check failed when the frame was rewritten after verification.
what_it_does_not_reach: The property says the suite can fail because a hypothesis of ours was wrong. D4.31 found a class it
cannot reach: the suite failing correctly, in a tree nobody ran it in.
A failing check is only useful where it is executed. Provenance is therefore part of the property,
not an operational detail beside it — tests/measurementProvenance.test.mjs makes each run state the
commit and a digest of the knowledge-base and services it measured.

$note: Three levels, kept apart because collapsing them is how 'all tests green' gets read as 'the
product is ready to ship'. D4.31 produced one failure at each, and they needed different people.
The outage was a Level 1 failure wearing a Level 2 disguise: the detector existed and was
correct, and the green number came from a tree nobody could name.

measurement_model.rule: A finding is evidential only when BOTH its correctness and its measurement provenance are established. Level 2 alone is not evidence about the product.
measurement_model.$why_separate: A Level 3 breach is not a Level 2 failure. The clause ceiling failing does not mean generation is broken, and reading it that way would either cause a panic or, worse, teach the reader to dismiss a red suite.

open_refinements.observation: A commit plus "3 uncommitted paths" does not uniquely identify a tree. Two machines can both report 0993c7ae6 + 3 uncommitted paths while holding different modifications.

A dimension is added when an investigation demonstrates that it can change a result. Building it now would be the premature abstraction this project refused in D4.29, in a new place.

FIXTURE_PROFILE from it — 14 tests and 22 probes — so every one of them fails at link time with
Among the fourteen: rosterConservation, economicAllocation, npartyClassification,

the D4.27 to D4.30 measurements actually used would silently change the evidence base for those
